items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Albert Alcorn, he left and went with Don Albert.

ctx.x: Yeah, the bass player I guess.

And Happy was playing, and she was playing bass and heavy band. It wasn't so long, you know, it's kind of, you played with so many different guys. Yeah. Albert was playing in that band too. Albert Alcorn, he left and went with Don Albert. He was playing in that band. And I don't know much as well. I don't think, I had a time of playing in there too. I can't think of them guys.
He probably had a big sax section I would guess.

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: Now Father Al has told me about him playing.

ctx.x: Was his band a big, loud band or soft, small band? No, he had a good, great band.

What kind, what size did he say? Same size as my band. In those days all bands were equal in size. 14, 15, 16 pieces. Now Father Al has told me about him playing. Who's that? Father Al Lewis. He's a banjo playing, get off that one. Maybe so.
I didn't know the personnel of the, of the, of the, of the, of the band. You knew about the band. He was a band.
